question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

Please give me one more _________ to prove my innocence.
solution:
The correct answer is: **chance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Chance"** refers to an opportunity to do something; a situation that makes it possible to do something; opportunity. (मौका)

 
 
• **Example: **She was given a chance to explain her side of the story.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that the author requested someone to provide him another opportunity to establish his innocence. 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the appropriate word to fill in the blank is **'chance'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. chance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **bet** (शर्त): An agreement to risk money on the result of a future event.

 
 
• **Example:** He made a bet on the horse race.
 
 
 
• **occasion** (अवसर): A particular time when something happens.
 
 
• **Example: **Her graduation was a joyous occasion for the whole family.
 
 
 
• **blind** (अंधा): Unable to see; lacking perception, awareness, or discernment.
 
 
• **Example:** The blind man navigated the city with his guide dog.
